description: This is a schematic representation illustrating the spatial arrangement of various land cover types. The diagram features a central, elongated water body, depicted in dark blue, representing a river or stream. Flanking both sides of this water body are areas classified as Grassland, shown in bright green. Clustered within these grassland areas, particularly on the upper bank of the water body, are groups of Trees, represented by small green canopy symbols. The broader landscape surrounding the grassland and water body is designated as Arable land, coloured in a light yellow hue, extending to the edges of the visible area. Additionally, thin light yellow lines, labelled as Roads, traverse the grassland areas. This schematic depicts a simplified landscape mosaic of a riparian zone or river valley.
